scope: Unified booking, measured intake with adjustments, care and quality checks, cancellation and reschedule; no payment obligation or pickup/delivery route

scenarioScope.B04-01: Quote snapshots server prices and holds capacity; idempotent booking creates one order and one reservation; obligation is B05
scenarioScope.B04-02: Stale quote version, expired hold, expired quote and stale order version all rejected with VERSION_CONFLICT or QUOTE_EXPIRED
scenarioScope.B04-03: Higher measured total proposes adjustment and blocks care until accepted; accepted adjustment returns to AT_FACILITY with new total; lower weight lowers bill without extra charge; decline holds at ON_HOLD with old total, care resumes after RESUME; adjustment expiry sweeps once with audit row
scenarioScope.B04-04: Partially covered: decline into hold, expiry into hold, lower-weight repricing covered; agreed unpaid return waits for B05 obligation
scenarioScope.B04-05: Pre-pickup cancellation releases capacity and completes when reconciliation facts verified; post-pickup stops at CANCEL_REQUESTED; reschedule moves reservation atomically; CONFIRM_CANCEL requires B05/B06 evidence

remaining: Payment obligation creation, receipts, settlement and refunds (B05)
Pickup and return legs, custody proof, rider assignment and tracking (B06)
Evidence uploads, media access and retention sweep (B07)
Incidents, rewash and verified consented reviews (B08)
WhatsApp drafts, exact confirmation and human escalation (B09)
Worker retries, dead letters, privacy jobs, observability (B10)
Design system, app foundations and three app screens (D01, F00-F04)
Integrated verification in PostgreSQL and browsers (E01)
Production readiness, migration rehearsal and launch handoff (E03)
C01 freeze, tariff approval, production ordering
